title: Reservations governance, partner enablement, and coordinated release-notes sprint for new regional instance families
creator: Leah Kim
description: Summary: Coordinate cross-functional launch activities for three new dedicated instance families (g9x-compact, g9x-highmem, g9x-burst) across EU-West-3 and APAC-SIN regions and the accompanying reservation bundles. This ticket centralizes governance decisions, release-notes sequencing, partner enablement artifacts, billing SKU mapping, and a go/no-go checklist for the release window. Objectives: (1) Ensure release notes are precise about fallback models and performance SLAs, (2) Align partner enablement collateral and reseller SKU matrix, (3) Sequence tenant onboarding messaging for Reserved vs Flex reservations, (4) Lock billing codes and usage metrics for cost reporting. Success metric: zero major support escalations attributable to incorrect reservation terms in first 30 days and partner enablement readiness for 95% of reseller partners prior to GA.

Rollout schedule confirmed with infra and capacity teams and gating toggles implemented for staged region enablement

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Billing SKU mismatch causes over/under-invoicing. Mitigation: two-pass validation with Finance and staging metering comparison; hold GA until reconciliation within tolerance.
Risk: Performance degrades under mixed reserved/burst traffic. Mitigation: enable canary routing and automatic fallback to lower-tier instance family; schedule soak test for 48 hours.
Risk: Release note language ambiguous about SLA/exclusions. Mitigation: Legal to review and add explicit examples of fallback behavior and refund policy.
Risk: Reseller partners not trained before activation. Mitigation: embargoed partner briefings 2 weeks before GA + live Q&A session and recorded demo
